entities.name: UniProt:P0DPJ7 Conotoxin reg3j
observations: Reviewed 17-aa peptide from Conus regius; the query sequence is an exact sequence match.
UniProt features report 4-hydroxyproline at position 5 and disulfide bonds Cys2–Cys16, Cys3–Cys14, and Cys8–Cys17.
Sequence analysis found no Pfam domain result; domain absence is not established for this 17-aa peptide.
